fields.title: Tighten the workspace lint table with suppression reasons, unwrap, leftover-macro, assertion-message and missing-docs lints
fields.description: Packages inheriting [workspace.lints] enable only cognitive_complexity, too_many_lines and fn_params_excessive_bools, while native Runledger denies unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo and reasonless suppressions and native Runlimit warns on missing_docs. Add clippy::allow_attributes, clippy::allow_attributes_without_reason, clippy::unwrap_used, clippy::dbg_macro, clippy::todo, clippy::missing_assert_message and rust missing_docs at warning level, enforced by the existing -D warnings verification. Replace #[allow] with reasoned #[expect] where the lint fires in every compiled configuration; keep any configuration-dependent suppression explicit with a reason. Remove the now-redundant crate-local #![warn(missing_docs)] attributes.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Workspace lint inheritors pass all four Clippy configurations with the new lints; every remaining suppression states a reason; docs/testing.md lint contract and the docs/status.md row describe the table; bash scripts/verify.sh passes on 1.98.1 and the outcome is recorded here.
fields.close_reason: Merged in PR #80 (e94c591). Added allow_attributes_without_reason, unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo, missing_assert_message and rust missing_docs to [workspace.lints]; omitted allow_attributes by decision so configuration-dependent suppressions stay reasoned allows. bash scripts/verify.sh passed on 1.98.1 (Linux). macOS Clippy unverified; crates/batter-core/tests/lifecycle.rs at 503 lines is a budget warning only.

comments.author: claude:8e9dd243-a809-4ec9-bfdb-9985b8e836dd@f29009df
comments.text: Implemented (uncommitted working tree, 161 files). [workspace.lints] adds rust missing_docs and clippy allow_attributes_without_reason, unwrap_used, dbg_macro, todo, missing_assert_message at warn; clippy::allow_attributes was dropped by user decision (runledger-style) because dead_code in shared test support varies per including crate. Root clippy.toml sets allow-unwrap-in-tests. Production: 93 batter-sqlx verification docs (privilege policy types moved to policy/privilege.rs with re-exports to keep policy.rs under its 800-line budget; public paths unchanged), 15 reference-service docs, build.rs crate docs, quota_service example now returns Result and propagates, runlimit http unwraps replaced (invariant expect; HeaderValue::from), 6 assertion messages, stable allows converted to reasoned expect (too_many_arguments x5, metrics-off dead_code/unused_variables). Kept reasoned allow: result_large_err (fires only on macOS) and large_enum_variant in atomic/fast.rs (208 bytes vs 200 threshold; macOS Instant size could flip it). Tests: 42 test roots gained //! docs; 78 test/bench roots carry reasoned crate-level allows for unwrap_used and missing_assert_message; unreachable_code (41) and length/complexity suppressions converted to reasoned expect; 12 stale too_many_lines suppressions removed; dead_code in shared support kept as reasoned allow. join_capture moved into startup_signals/scenario.rs to keep startup_signals.rs within its 800-line budget. Verification: bash scripts/verify.sh passed on Rust 1.98.1 (exit 0), after a first run failed only on the file budget (fixed); scripts matrix part rerun after a docs wording edit passed; workspace clippy with default and no-default features also clean. Limitations: Clippy on macOS not run; crates/batter-core/tests/lifecycle.rs now 503 lines (budget warning, not error). Tracker publish blocked by JOURNAL_FORK (machine identity used from two places).

fields.title: Pin Send on the canonical public futures

data.text: Implemented (uncommitted). crates/batter-sqlx/tests/future_size.rs and crates/batter-runlimit/tests/future_size.rs bounded() now require Future + Send. New crates/batter-core/tests/send_futures.rs type-checks every public batter-core future against Send inputs (run_until drivers, supervisor waiters, lifecycle signals, process receipts, health, cleanup, startup/command/service waiters, operation, retry, bulkhead). Negative control: an Rc held across LifecycleStatus::wait_ready failed the target with E0277, then restored. docs/testing.md, docs/status.md row and CHANGELOG updated. bash scripts/verify.sh passed on Rust 1.98.1 (Linux), including send_futures and future_size debug and release. macOS unverified; adapter futures outside the size tests stay covered only where tests spawn or route them.

Committed as 246f354 on branch test/send-futures-m5g4; PR https://github.com/bpcakes/batter/pull/82 against master (e94c591). Verification unchanged from the recorded verify.sh pass; close after merge.

fields.description: User-authorized implementation: replace consumer coordination of OperationPhases work/finalization with a protected owned runner, reusing command lifecycle machinery where appropriate; add protected cleanup acquisition that registers finalization before exposing an acquired handle. Preserve separate errors, inert factories, bounded phases, downward cancellation, and explicit weaker escape hatches.
fields.acceptance_criteria: Owned phase runner prevents early finalization access and invokes finalization after retained work outcomes; work and finalization failures survive waiter cancellation/owner loss under documented policy. Protected acquisition registers before returning the handle with failure/cancellation coverage. Public docs/examples, ADR-010 assessment, status/contracts and API compatibility decision updated. Focused adversarial tests and complete pinned verify.sh results recorded.
fields.title: Own work-to-finalization sequencing and cleanup acquisition handoff

data.text: Plan and assessment: T1 reuse command run_work as a generic private phase poller, add inert PhasedOperation with work-only callback and delayed FinalizationScope callback, retained typed phase reports and owner/observer completion. Parent cancellation affects both phases; owner loss cancels work only and retained coordinator attempts finalization. T2 opaque Acquired handle/finalizer returned by native factory, consumed by CleanupSlot::acquire before exposing handle, preserving LIFO. T3 migrate outbound facade example and add compile-fail/runtime boundary controls; document raw OperationPhases and manual slot registration as weaker compatibility paths. T4 full pinned verify.sh once after focused checks and additive API surface review. Dependencies T1/T2 -> T3 -> T4. No destructive cut intended. Risks: work destruction panic, finalizer factory panic, ready output retention, parent-vs-owner cancellation, unpolled/drop, resource pairing before native factory completion. Runtime death/non-yielding tasks, unsupervised descendants and remote effects remain outside local proof.

Implementation progress: 12 phased-operation failure cases, 4 acquisition cases and 4 Send-contract checks passed; 78 core doctests passed. Canonical wait now returns PhasedFailure::Report whenever either phase fails (independent typed outcomes retained), preventing ? from treating completion as success. Initial full verify was intentionally stopped during Clippy before any successful matrix completion to make this review correction. No code/dependency commit made. Raw outbound example kept explicit because generic cancellation-first polling must not discard its transport-specific ready Exchange; recorded in ADR-010.

Public surface review: pinned rustdoc JSON structural comparison against 316e721bd52b58219d5ef213da9000532a0df520 found 1122 -> 1172 entries, zero removals and 50 additions. Manual signature/bounds review found no existing public contract changes; only command private poller generalized. Evidence saved at docs/evidence/public-api-diff-2026-10-09/phased-operation-2026-11-05.txt. No deprecated shim or Breaking entry required. Focused Clippy now passes. Complete verify.sh restarted after checked-wait correction.

Updated usage navigation to the owned runner and protected acquisition, with explicit distinction for the provider-specific manual exchange protocol. Strict file-budget inventory checked all 1094 governed files with zero errors (existing inventory warnings retained). Runtime and docs checks are Linux-only; no macOS execution claimed.

Delivered and verified on Linux with pinned Rust 1.98.1: bash scripts/verify.sh exited 0, completing formatting, file budgets, all four Clippy configurations, all six matrix parts, rustdoc, and all five HTTP smoke invocations. Parsed 44 subprocess summaries: all status 0, no watchdogs/errors. Focused 12 phased lifecycle tests, 4 acquisition tests and 4 Send-contract tests passed; core 78 doctests passed. Final local file budget and git diff --check pass; strict whole inventory previously had zero errors with existing warnings. Public API diff: 50 additive entries, zero removals; manual signature review no existing public changes. Cargo.lock and dependency graph unchanged. No macOS or fresh-agent evaluation claimed; no code commit/push/publication. Parent cancellation intentionally affects both phases, owner drop only work; remote effects, partial native acquisition, arbitrary spawned descendants and runtime death remain explicit boundaries.
